2026-11-20T05:13Z · **This card now carries a fold group.** Shared mechanism: multi-holder metadata-protocol reads: one name held by several packages (enabled, disabled, package-less) answers inconsistently across the doc, layered, listing and hydration doors. The cards below, unclaimed and unstarted, are closed into this one so a single claimant fixes them in one PR. Each row's source card keeps its full body; this card closes when every row below and its own ask are done. Grade stays the highest of the group.

- [ ] #34440 (p3) metadata-protocol: a package-less row beside a disabled holder and served holders is served by save order on the plain read and /published, while /layers refuses naming the disabled package — read #34440 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #34417 (p3) metadata-protocol: after hydration, the first holder's exact address of a doc two packages ship serves the environment's package-less row instead of that package's own doc — read #34417 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #34346 (p3) metadata-protocol: with two enabled holders and a stored row bound to a disabled holder, a bare save writes one enabled holder's row and a bare draft save or delete addresses the disabled holder's row, while the bare read refuses 409 — read #34346 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #34258 (p3) metadata-protocol: the package-less withhold for an action judges the name's holders, not the row's (object, name) key, so an enabled holder on another object keeps a disabled key's customization served — read #34258 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #34190 (p3) metadata-protocol: the layered read of a doc name two enabled packages hold answers one holder's layers while the plain read refuses (ADR-0150 D3/D5) — read #34190 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #33904 (p3) metadata-protocol: the merged action listing leaves out the environment package-less row on another object while the by-name read serves it — read #33904 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #33127 (p3) metadata-protocol: after a restart, two stored rows of one name that each name a different holder leave only the last one loaded, for every package-slotted type (tool, webhook, …) — read #33127 for its full detail and acceptance.
